children: EUROPE BEFORE THE BELL: SLIGHTLY SOFTER
European stock futures are slightly lower on Tuesday, suggesting indexes will fall for a second day, as oil prices climbed and bond yields rose to multi-year highs.
are down about 0.1%, after the index dropped 1% on Monday.
Futures on the CAC (FCEc1) and FTSE
are also a touch softer, while DAX futures

Attention remains on oil and gas prices, which are creeping higher again on Tuesday after the Iran-aligned Houthis launched a new wave of attacks on Saudi Arabia, further threatening already-strained global energy supplies.
Tech stocks could also be in focus for a second day after industry leaders called for a slowdown in AI development.
Europe's banks are also a sector to watch at the open after Bank of America CEO Brian Moynihan said on Monday that he expects investment banking fees to drop by at least 10% in the third quarter.
